experiments.description: Compare whole-state root freshness rejection with complete dependency-scoped freshness under unrelated state churn.
experiments.boundary: Constructed sparse-key workload with complete dependency knowledge; not a FRANK benchmark.

experiments.description: Inject hidden dependencies into dependency-scoped freshness validation.
experiments.result: Scoped freshness is unsafe when its dependency closure is incomplete; unknown/dynamic effects require conservative escalation.

experiments.description: Compare model-claimed dependency footprints with footprints deterministically derived from typed operation semantics.
experiments.boundary: Constructed typed operations; establishes a safety design counterexample, not production completeness of a compiler.

experiments.result: Independent execution replicated the direction of the local result; absolute miss rate is workload-dependent.

experiments.description: Pure-Python SHA-256 Merkle tree with 16,384 leaves; compare full root reconstruction with verifying eight inclusion proofs.
experiments.boundary: Microbenchmark only; targeted witness validation does not by itself prove current-state freshness or semantic correctness.

experiments.evidence: Hugging Face model discovery succeeded and exposed the target model, but chat inference returned HTTP 402 monthly included credits depleted before a response was produced.
experiments.promotion_effect: No reader-performance or token-efficiency claim is promoted from this attempt.
